title: fusion.implementer-request/v1
description: DRAFT, plan step 12: the code-implementer's immutable role input, the profile's input_schema, composed for the implement step of workflows/repair.v1.json and frozen by the host through host.role.compose.v1 (proposed by request 69) before the attempt's first role call. The module's task carries brief, write_paths, checks, workspace and attempt and nothing else; the host adds project_context and output_contract and refuses a task that already carries a field of either name (67.2), validates the composed object against this schema and answers the frozen bytes, which travel unchanged as RoleCall.input on every role call of the run. The implementer works in workspace.root, an isolated host workspace detached at base_revision, with writes confined to write_paths; whether its grant includes the process tool class to run checks itself is request 69's question (67.2: the implementer's process tools stay with 69), and the host runs checks in host.capture.v1 either way. No $schema keyword: the host compiles every bundle schema as draft 2020-12 and this file must carry no URL.

brief.description: Module's task: the request's summary and criteria, the paths the explorer read, and the explorer's settled result (W4 of 261010-1504-span-map-and-repair-correspondence.md, Prior's embedded brief composition E7).

exploration.description: The explore step's result, valid against schemas/explorer-result.v1.json; typed loosely here so that this schema never restates that one.

write_paths.description: Module's task: the bound write scope, the request's write_paths unchanged.

checks.description: Module's task: the request's checks unchanged, under the request's bound (every check mandatory, none expected to fail), so the implementer knows what the host will run.

workspace.description: Module's task, from the workspace step's answer: the isolated workspace this attempt writes in.

root.description: An absolute path on the host; the only tree the implementer's tools reach.

attempt.description: Module's task: which attempt this is and, after a revise verdict, the review that asked for it.

previous_review.description: null on attempt 0; otherwise the previous attempt's review-response, valid against schemas/review-response.v1.json, typed loosely here.

output_contract.description: Host-added: the parsed object of the profile's result_schema asset, schemas/implementer-result.v1.json. The host validates the role's answer against that same object.

project_context.description: Host-added: the project instruction files the host selected, root AGENTS.md falling back to CLAUDE.md, empty when neither exists. A reference to CLAUDE.md in the role's neutral text means these entries.
